description: Move objects by id, in ONE batch call: each answer carries the object's id, type, version, owner and its decoded Move fields under json. Up to 50 ids per request and nothing is trimmed from the reply, so no cursor is issued. An id the node cannot serve is reported POSITIONALLY under failed, with its request index, the id asked for and the gRPC status, never dropped in silence. Reads only.

ids.description: Object ids to read, 50 at most. Order is preserved and a failure keeps its position.

version.description: Read this past version instead of the live object. A decimal string, because an object version is a u64. Single id only.

name: suiGetObjects
title: Sui objects by id
